title: Asahina Mafuyu — Desolate Kitchen〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You've stopped eating.
Are you done?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. No, I was just thinking. I'll eat.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh... No, I'll pass.
I'd like to get right back to work.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
There's something I'd like to ask you regarding N25, if that's alright.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You know, that message from K took us both by surprise. What's all this “I want to work alone for a while” stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd like to work alone for a while so I can focus more on what I'm doing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I know this is asking a lot of you, but would it be possible for you to work in the bedroom?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, and please feel free to eat and take baths whenever you like. You don't have to mind me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It sounds like she won't be logging into Nightcord for a little while, either.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So let me know if you need something from K. I'll tell her myself.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K must be really motivated about completing this song, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. Let's do what we can on our end so she can work in peace.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sounds good! Then, let's all do our best♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, what's that supposed to mean? You're making it sound like we're really obnoxious normally.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <To tell you the truth, I was also thinking that something didn't feel right. Maybe that's why we weren't talking as much as we usually do?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, it isn't exactly business as usual.
Maybe because it's just the three of us right now...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But this isn't the first time that we've been down to just three.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <For example, whenever I've been busy or that time I went on the school trip, the three of you kept on working.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now that you mention it, I've also been gone a few times...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, when you really think about it, it's pretty rare for K to be the one who's not around, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I guess...
The only time I can think of was when Yuki wanted to stay in SEKAI. K volunteered to write lyrics and mix songs all by herself.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hmm... I can't think of any other examples. How about you, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K has been composing songs this entire time to fulfill the promise she made to me...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And she seems particularly interested in completing this song. I can't wait to hear what it's like.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm sure she's going to produce something really good.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'm gonna mute myself and get back to work. Let me know if anything comes up.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'll do the same. Oh, but I'm always happy to chat about stuff♪>
